purpose: Follow-up to ptbxl_v2_lda_seed42, whose prespecified grid selected its upper edge (256) with validation AUROC still rising. Same pipeline, wider grid, selection on validation only. Specified after the first LDA test result had been seen; reported alongside it, not instead of it.

preprocessing.pooling: 2x2 maximum ink; isotropic factor2, no interpolation
preprocessing.normalization: one global mean/std from training pixels only
preprocessing.calibration: per-lead calibration pulses retained in pixels; no numeric metadata feature
preprocessing.limitation: downsampling thickens narrow strokes and merges fine detail; variable page gain retained; not lossless waveform reconstruction

loss: unweighted binary cross entropy with logits; five independent binary targets
selection_rule: Choose PCA component count by validation macro ROC-AUC, then macro AP, then -BCE, then fewer components
threshold_policy: fixed sigmoid probability >=0.5; no threshold search
test_policy: One test inference per run after the selected checkpoint is frozen and reloaded. Fold 10 was already observed for earlier PTB-XL models, so comparisons are exploratory; no test-based tuning.

uncertainty.method: patient-cluster percentile bootstrap of final test predictions
uncertainty.scope: test-sampling uncertainty conditional on this fitted model; excludes seed/training/external-domain variation

lda_reduction: 8x8 nonoverlapping area mean of the cached 12x120x1120 ink image -> 12x15x140 = 25,200 features, float16 storage; no per-feature scaling
